note: Illustrative adjudications. Development cases are the ones the method was built against; held-out cases are never tuned on. The `heldout-*` cases are synthetic: they exist to exercise the evidence ceiling (independent sources, derived sources, contradiction), not to estimate real-world attribution accuracy.

cases.question: Are APT28 and APT29 the same actor?

evidence.statement: Separate, unrelated codebases
Separate dedicated infrastructure
Some shared tradecraft (non-diagnostic)

cases.question: Are Scattered Spider and UNC3944 the same actor?

evidence.statement: Consistent operator fingerprint (distinctive self-identification, unique handles)
Shared infrastructure
Same tooling

cases.question: Is VOLTZITE the same actor as Volt Typhoon?

evidence.statement: Dragos describes 'extensive technical overlaps' rather than identity
VOLTZITE is an analyst designation for the OT-facing activity
MITRE records the names as Associated Groups, weaker than 'same actor'
SYLVANITE hands footholds onward
Same targeting and tradecraft (non-diagnostic)

cases.question: Are GHOSTLARK and EMBERWAKE the same actor?

The passive DNS history overlaps on two bulletproof resellers
